title: VTG Yugioh World Suppression PSV-020 1st Edition
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The VTG Yugioh World Suppression PSV-020 1st Edition card is a vintage collectible card from the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG. Manufactured in 1996 by Konami, this Light attribute trap-normal card features the World Suppression character as an Angel-type creature. Part of the Pharaoh's Servant set, this English language card is made of standard card stock with a regular finish. A common card, it holds value for collectors and fans of the game looking to add a rare and unique piece to their collection.
